title: Lanterns for the Mirefen Crossing
story: Mirefen the Fogmother drapes the swamp causeway in mist so thick that travelers wander in circles forever. Mr 6 learns she can't cross the light of a swamp-lantern, and each lantern brightens exactly 14 paces of causeway. The village has a stack of lanterns and a very nervous group of travelers waiting.
question: The causeway is 218 paces long. If each lantern lights 14 paces, how many lanterns are needed to light the whole causeway?
hint: Divide 218 by 14 — but check the remainder. A partly-lit stretch still needs its own lantern.
victory: Mr 6 hung the sixteenth lantern over the last soggy six paces, and Mirefen curled up into a harmless puff of steam. 'Fifteen would have left a gap,' he said, 'and gaps are where fog lives.'
imagePrompt: A swirling gray fog-woman coiling above a plank causeway through a moonlit swamp, with a line of glowing lanterns and a tiny caped numeral 6 hanging the last one.
